infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Sawaal Jawaab uses the microphone so you can say your question out loud instead of typing it.
infoPlist.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: Sawaal Jawaab turns what you say into a written question you can show someone.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Sawaal Jawaab can show your location on your emergency card, so someone helping you knows where you are.
